author: Christian Kanzian
name: quicktag
description: Adds a lighttable module and shortcuts with configurable buttons for quickly attaching frequently used tags to images.
description-extensive: If you find yourself applying the same keywords to your photos over and over, this adds handy buttons and keyboard shortcuts so you can attach your favorite tags with a single click. You choose how many quick-tag slots you want and assign a tag to each one. It makes organizing and labeling large batches of images much faster.
